blocks.text: Copies are all we need for the records Mary described. Scans or photographs taken on a phone are fine, and the originals should stay in the company's files where they are now.

Please send items to me as they turn up, without waiting to gather everything first. I log each one against the matter with the date it reached us, so nothing goes missing between our office and Kelly's review.
If any use took place outside the United States, a note of the country will do for now. We will come back to you if it bears on the review of {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}}'s mark.
Kelly is still glad to take the call Mary mentioned, if you would rather walk through what you have before sending it.
